title: 迁移规格列表及品类编辑器视觉
input: 现有/admin/specs SSR categoryMeta列表、品类SpecEditor和specs.css，既有GET/PUT规格接口。
output: legacy-specs-ui；SSR规格导航及原编辑表单统一视觉，不变规格业务。
acceptance: 真实ADMIN和EDITOR分别登录，点击后台“产品规格”到/admin/specs；服务端HTML中categoryMeta每个key恰有一个/admin/specs/{key}链接。点击corrugated-boxes链接后pathname=/admin/specs/corrugated-boxes，GET /api/admin/specs/corrugated-boxes=200，JSON.category=corrugated-boxes且Cache-Control含no-store；点击“全部品类”后pathname=/admin/specs。登录SALES直接开这两页均404，GET/PUT规格接口403；ADMIN请求未知category的GET/PUT为404、error=not_found。

在隔离数据库通过原编辑控件设置material en=Visual test EN、material ru=Visual test RU、notes en=note EN、notes ru=note RU，size min的l/w/h=10/20/30、size max=40/50/60、单位mm，moq value=123、单位pcs，lead time min/max=7/14、单位day，样品费选择free；清空认证，贸易术语只选FOB。点击唯一submit“保存”只发一次PUT /api/admin/specs/corrugated-boxes，body恰含size/material/moq/sampleFee/leadTime/certifications/tradeTerms/notes八键，各嵌套值等于上述输入，certifications=null、sampleFee={free:true}、tradeTerms=[FOB]。响应200，category等于corrugated-boxes、updatedAt为ISO时间，八字段逐项等于body；随后真实GET=200且八字段及updatedAt逐项等于PUT响应。刷新浏览器触发GET后material/notes、六尺寸、MOQ、交期、free与FOB控件值逐项等于上述输入，status结果区可见已保存文案。

在同一表单只将moq value改0并点击保存，观察1秒PUT请求增加0，role=alert含1与100000000的范围提示，material en和moq value仍分别为Visual test EN和0。服务端原错误协议复用既有API用例：ADMIN同源PUT含moq.value=0返回400/error=invalid，issues中含path=moq.value；随后GET的moq.value仍123。测试只消费现有规则，不增加端点、字段、品类或PDP。

必读07/11/12，只消费minimalist-flat。1920×1080、1440×900、390×844逐项记录真实列表→编辑→保存→返回GIF和GET/PUT网络证据。对.spec-sec、material en输入和保存按钮测border各边=2px且rgb(0,0,0)、borderRadius各角=0px、boxShadow=none、backgroundImage=none；Tab到material en后document.activeElement就是该input，focus-visible的outlineWidth=2px/offset=2px/color=rgb(180,87,0)。桌面按钮/单行输入高36px、触屏目标矩形至少44×44px，单行输入字号16px、表格标签14px/20px；D1–D6/overflow按列表work、编辑form记录，gutter/gap/pad=16px、work fill≥0.85、form fill≥0.55且左边缘≤gutter+24px、block gap≤24px/card pad≤20px、页面scrollWidth≤clientWidth。在相同表单数据/展开状态下比较迁移前后，六尺寸、MOQ、费用、认证与双语字段的DOM数量相等，必要文字可换行；loading/empty/error/success/disabled/focus逐态留下断言，不删字段或动作取得通过。（E-109）

edge.scene: 既有规格列表和编辑器视觉统一
edge.trigger: ADMIN或EDITOR通过规格列表选择既存品类并编辑、验证和保存规格
edge.expect: SSR品类列表和GET/PUT原协议、角色限制不变；必要字段/双语标签/校验错误和保存控件全部可见且可键盘操作，三尺寸D1–D6/overflow/真实GIF及保存后GET证明风格升级没有删功能。

en.title: Migrate specification listing and category editor visuals
en.input: Existing /admin/specs SSR categoryMeta list, SpecEditor/specs.css and actual GET/PUT specification APIs.
en.output: Existing SSR category navigation and specification editor in the locked visual system, with unchanged business rules.
en.accept: 1) Actual ADMIN and EDITOR each sign in and click Product specifications to /admin/specs. Server HTML contains exactly one /admin/specs/{key} link for every categoryMeta key. Click corrugated-boxes: pathname is /admin/specs/corrugated-boxes; GET /api/admin/specs/corrugated-boxes returns 200, JSON.category=corrugated-boxes and Cache-Control contains no-store. Click All categories: pathname is /admin/specs. Signed-in SALES gets 404 for both pages and 403 for GET/PUT specification APIs. ADMIN GET/PUT to an unknown category returns 404/error=not_found. 2) In an isolated database use original controls to set material en=Visual test EN, material ru=Visual test RU, notes en=note EN, notes ru=note RU; size min l/w/h=10/20/30 and max=40/50/60, unit mm; moq value=123, unit pcs; lead time min/max=7/14, unit day; sample fee=free; remove all certifications and select only FOB. Click the single submit Save: exactly one PUT /api/admin/specs/corrugated-boxes is sent. Its body has exactly eight keys size/material/moq/sampleFee/leadTime/certifications/tradeTerms/notes, each nested value equals those entered, certifications=null, sampleFee={free:true}, tradeTerms=[FOB]. Response is 200 with category=corrugated-boxes, ISO updatedAt and all eight fields equal to the body. Subsequent actual GET is 200 and all eight fields plus updatedAt equal the PUT response. Browser reload issues GET and each material/notes/six dimensions/MOQ/lead-time/free/FOB control retains the submitted value; a status result contains the saved message. 3) In that form change only moq value to 0 and click Save. Over one second the PUT request count increases by zero, a role=alert shows the range containing 1 and 100000000, and material en/moq inputs still contain Visual test EN/0. Reuse the original API rejection test: ADMIN same-origin PUT with moq.value=0 returns 400/error=invalid and an issues entry path=moq.value; subsequent GET moq.value remains 123. Consume existing validation only, with no new endpoint, field, category or PDP. 4) Read 07/11/12 and consume only locked minimalist-flat. At 1920x1080,1440x900,390x844 record actual list-to-editor-to-save-to-return GIF and GET/PUT evidence. For .spec-sec, material en input and Save button, all computed borders are 2px rgb(0,0,0), all corner radii=0px, boxShadow=none, backgroundImage=none. Tab to material en: document.activeElement is that input and focus-visible outlineWidth=2px, outlineOffset=2px, outlineColor=rgb(180,87,0). Desktop buttons/single-line inputs are 36px high; touch rectangles are at least 44x44px. Single-line input font size is 16px, table labels 14px/20px. Record D1-D6/overflow for work listing and form editor: gutter/gap/pad=16px, work fill>=0.85, form fill>=0.55 and left edge<=gutter+24px, block gap<=24px, card padding<=20px, page scrollWidth<=clientWidth. With the same form data and expanded state, DOM counts for six dimensions, MOQ, fee, certifications and bilingual fields equal their pre-migration counts, with necessary text wrapping. Assert loading/empty/error/success/disabled/focus states; delete no field/action to obtain a pass. E-109.
en.scene: Visual consistency of the existing specification listing and editor
en.trigger: ADMIN or EDITOR selects an existing category through the specification listing and edits, validates and saves its fields.
en.expect: Preserve SSR category data, original GET/PUT protocol and permissions. Required bilingual fields, labels, validation messages and Save remain visible and keyboard usable. Three-viewport density/overflow/real-GIF and post-save GET evidence proves the style migration removes no function.
